title.zh: 同分异构体 · 同一组原子，不同的拼法
title.en: Isomers · The Same Atoms, Put Together Differently

desc.zh: 分子式相同、原子连接方式不同，就是不同的分子：数骨架、判断“画法不同还是分子不同”，再看单键与双键怎样让镜像般的异构体分得开。
desc.en: Same molecular formula, different connections between atoms, means different molecules: count the skeletons, tell "drawn differently" from "really different", and see why double bonds keep cis and trans apart.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
